name: request-response
title: Request/response
summary: Windowed request/reply round trips over one established link.
description: Windowed request/reply round trips over one link - the network's most common interactive pattern (page fetches, queries, telemetry). Each varied-size request names a varied response size. Requests per second is the primary comparison; fractional-millisecond p50 and p99 wall-clock RTT remain visible beside it.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts + raced; every response carries exactly the byte count its request named. Any implementation-local loopback race is counted explicitly instead of disappearing from accounting.
